questions.stem: In a double circulatory system, what happens to the blood between passing through the lungs and reaching the body tissues?

options.text: It returns to the heart to be pumped out again at high pressure
It is filtered by the kidneys before entering arteries
It mixes with deoxygenated blood in the vena cava
It flows directly to the body without returning to the heart

questions.explanation: In double circulation, blood returns to the heart after visiting the lungs, allowing it to be pumped out a second time at high pressure to reach the body tissues efficiently.
